messages.subject: ET1 received from the tribunal
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

We've had an ET1 through from Watford (case 3304127/2025). I think Rashid lodged it protectively before we finished the settlement paperwork. Do we still need to file an ET3, or will this be withdrawn now it's settled? Scanned ET1 is on the system (Rashid_ET1_ClaimForm).

Helen

messages.subject: RE: ET1 received from the tribunal
messages.plaintextBody:
Helen,

Yes — because the claim is live we should file a protective ET3 (grounds of resistance) to avoid a default judgment, then notify the tribunal that the matter has settled and that the claim is being withdrawn under the COT3/settlement. I'll prepare the ET3 and liaise with Birchall Stone on the withdrawal. Belt and braces.

Tom

Helen,

Yes — because the claim is live we should file a protective ET3 (grounds of resistance) to avoid a default judgment, then notify the tribunal that the matter has settled and that the claim is being withdrawn under the COT3/settlement. I'll prepare the ET3 and liaise with Birchall Stone on the withdrawal. Belt and braces.

Tom
